findings.evidence: `def trace (P : OpenEar S) : N.Subnetwork := P.walk.trace`; each proof is literally `ArrowWalk.trace_vertexSet P.walk`.
findings.fix: Delete the four ear-level lemmas. Make OpenEar.trace/ClosedEar.trace reducible (abbrev), or drop them and use P.walk.trace directly, so the ArrowWalk.trace_* simp lemmas apply.
findings.issue: OpenEar.trace_vertexSet/trace_arrowSet (and ClosedEar.trace_vertexSet/trace_arrowSet, lines 204/208) restate ArrowWalk.trace_vertexSet/trace_arrowSet up to unfolding, since OpenEar.trace and ClosedEar.trace are defined as P.walk.trace.

findings.evidence: Subnetwork.lean:176 `@[simp] theorem sup_vertexSet (S T) : (S ⊔ T).vertexSet = S.vertexSet ∪ T.vertexSet`, and :180 `sup_arrowSet`. `adjoin P := S ⊔ P.trace`.
findings.fix: Remove all four. Downstream, `simp [OpenEar.adjoin]` (or an `adjoin` abbrev) closes these goals with `Subnetwork.sup_vertexSet`, `Subnetwork.sup_arrowSet`, `ArrowWalk.trace_vertexSet` and `ArrowWalk.trace_arrowSet`.
findings.issue: OpenEar.adjoin_vertexSet/adjoin_arrowSet and ClosedEar.adjoin_vertexSet/adjoin_arrowSet (lines 232/238) are composite simp lemmas that the existing simp lemmas Subnetwork.sup_vertexSet/sup_arrowSet plus the trace lemmas already prove. They also reprove that by hand through vertexSet_union.

findings.evidence: Lines 144-153 and 220-229 are character-for-character the same proofs (`Set.disjoint_left`, `Network.Subnetwork.le_union_left _ _`). `Ear.le_adjoin` and `Ear.trace_le_adjoin` (283-292) only case-split back into them.
findings.fix: Define the ear's walk once on Ear (e.g. `Ear.walk : (P : Ear S) → ArrowWalk N.Hom _ _`, or a shared source/target accessor). Define `Ear.trace := P.walk.trace` and `Ear.adjoin := S ⊔ P.trace`, and prove `le_adjoin` (`le_sup_left`), `trace_le_adjoin` (`le_sup_right`) and `disjoint_arrowSet` once there. Remove the per-kind copies.
findings.issue: OpenEar and ClosedEar each define their own copies of adjoin, le_adjoin, disjoint_arrowSet and trace with identical bodies. Ear.trace/Ear.adjoin then dispatch to them, giving three parallel APIs for the same construction.

summary: No existing ear or ear-decomposition API was found in Mathlib or Tau Ceti, but the PR copies the same ear API into both OpenEar and ClosedEar, and several of those lemmas only restate existing simp lemmas.
